article.title: Oklahoma City plays Denver in conference matchup
article.linkText: Oklahoma City plays Denver in conference matchup
article.story: Denver Nuggets vs. Oklahoma City Thunder Oklahoma City; Thursday, 9:30 p.m. EDT LINE: Thunder -8.5; over/under is 236.5 BOTTOM LINE: Western Conference foes Oklahoma City and Denver square off. Oklahoma City went 64-18 overall and 12-4 in Northwest Division action last season. The Thunder averaged 119.0 points per game last season, 19.0 on free throws and 41.4 from beyond the arc. Denver finished 54-28 overall and 36-16 in Western Conference action during the 2025-26 season. The Nuggets averaged 29.0 assists per game on 43.5 made field goals last season. INJURIES: Thunder: Nikola Topic: out (back), Thomas Sorber: out (knee), Otega Oweh: out for season (achilles). Nuggets: Julian Strawther: out (knee). ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
